inline_comments.comment: `(config as any)._unwrap` is used twice in this block but nowhere else in the function — Scenario 2 at line 145 calls `config._unwrap(...)` directly (no cast, just the existing `eslint-disable-next-line no-underscore-dangle` comment). The new code should follow that established pattern for consistency.

general_comments.comment: The `_unwrap` call in the early-return block is specifically intended to handle TS assertion wrappers (e.g., `export default defineMain({}) as StorybookConfig` or `satisfies StorybookConfig`), but the existing test at line 169 only covers the plain `export default defineMain({})` case. A test that passes already-transformed code with TS assertion wrappers (both `as` and `satisfies` variants) should be added to verify the early return fires correctly in those cases and provide a regression net for the `_unwrap` code path.
